title: Principal Controller of Communication Accounts releases schedule for Telecom Pensioners Jeevan Praman Camps across Delhi NCR for the month of November
body_text: Principal Controller of Communication Accounts, Department of Telecom (DoT) is organizing Telecom Pensioners Jeevan Praman Camps during the month of      November , 2026 in the premises O/o Pr. CCA Delhi, Delhi Sanchar Lekha Bhawan, Prasad Nagar, New Delhi-110005, Extn. Counter at Eastern Court Janpath, New Delhi and premises of MTNL at various locations across Delhi NCR for the convenience of Pensioners. Pensioners are requested to attend these camps and avail facilities as per their convenience along with relevant documents on the spot verification of Life Certificate. The schedules of Pensioner Facilitation Camp mentioned as under: Sl. No. Location दिनांक 1. C-10 Yamuna Vihar Main Exchange Building , Delhi 03.11.2026 2. Laxmi Nagar, MTNL Exchange , Building, Delhi 06.11.2026 3. Nehru Place MTNL Exchange Building, New Delhi 10.11.2026 4. MTNL Exchange Building, Sector-6 Dwarka, Delhi 13.11.2026 5. MTNL Exchange Building, Sector-3 Rohini, Delhi 16.11.2026 6. MTNL Exchange Building Janak Puri, New Delhi 18.11.2026 7. CSC BSNL Exchange Building Sector-12 Gurugram, Haryana 20.11.2026 8. BSNL Exchange Building Sector GMT-15 Building Faridabad, Haryana 23.11.2026 9. BSNL Telephone Exchange Building Sector-19, NOIDA 25.11.2026 10. MTNL Exchange Building Narela, Delhi 27.11.2026 Timing of Facilitation Camps: 11.00 AM to 4.00 PM Facilities available at Pensioners Facilitation Camps: Training for submitting Digital Life certificate submission at www.jeevanpramaan.gov.in Training for usage of Jeevan  Praman Face Authentication application Submission of KYP forms – Please bring one photograph and copy of Aadhar Card/PAN card/copy of PPO Grievances and query submission. Note : Those pensioners who have already submitted their life certificate may not attend the camps for the same. ***** AMK/AR
